title: Preventive maintenance without defined completion

retrieve_on.symptom_narrative: A visit usually means asking whether anything is broken and getting a signature. Different technicians check different things. We sometimes return for scheduled maintenance days after an emergency visit, yet a signed sheet can hide an inaccessible computer room.
retrieve_on.workflow_context: 11 staff; 38 school contracts with regular visits and reactive support.

discriminating_questions.question: Does the contract require a visit or named checks?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Several agreements list checks; others only specify frequency.
discriminating_questions.diagnostic_value: Obligations must be interpreted per agreement.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Where the agreement explicitly requires a distinct scheduled attendance, combining trips requires customer agreement even if checks overlap.

discriminating_questions.question: Did emergency work satisfy those checks?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: The technician fixed one printer but did not inspect the lab.
discriminating_questions.diagnostic_value: Attendance cannot substitute for task evidence.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.question: How are inaccessible rooms recorded?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: The whole visit is marked complete.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.question: Can visits be combined?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: The customer permits it if checks are done within the due period.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

positive_mechanism: The system tracks attendance instead of contract-level maintenance obligations and partial completion.
counterexample: Where the agreement explicitly requires a distinct scheduled attendance, combining trips requires customer agreement even if checks overlap.
minimum_evidence: A simulated contract extract lists printer inspection and workstation checks.
A simulated report has a signature but no lab checklist.
A simulated access note records a locked room.
process_intervention: Translate reviewed contracts into task lists; distinguish attended, partially completed and obligation fulfilled.
automation_candidate: Track due tasks per site and asset; suggest combining eligible checks with reactive visits; carry incomplete work forward.
unknowns: Ambiguous contract wording needs human interpretation before scheduling rules are encoded.
stop_rule: If discriminating evidence is absent or conflicting, return an unresolved hypothesis plus a targeted question, not a confident solution.

capability_boundary.proposed_extension: Contract obligation modelling and preventive scheduling are new capabilities.
capability_boundary.pricing: No price assigned; current rate card must not be extended by analogy.
